title: 第5章 自创功法第6章 入修行
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
林道缓缓地盘膝坐下，双眼微闭，调整呼吸，将自己的心神逐渐沉入，那片神秘的金色识海之中。
他深知自己毫无修行功法的经验，要想凭借一己之力，自创出一门强大的功法，其难度犹如登天。
然而，他也明白功法并非天生而就，而是由前人智慧与努力共同创造而成。
既然如此，为何自己不能成为那个创造者呢？
想到这里，林道心中燃起一丝希望之光。
他将目光投向，自己体内那神秘莫测的金色识海。
直觉告诉他，这或许就是他突破困境、开辟新道路的关键所在。
毕竟，这片金色识海赋予了，他过目不忘的神奇能力。
甚至连前世的记忆，都能够如电影般清晰地呈现在眼前。
不过，这些仅仅只是，金色识海展现出的冰山一角罢了。
实际上，对于这片识海的真正奥秘，林道心里已然有了一些大胆的猜测。
随着心神不断深入金色识海，时间一分一秒过去，林道的意识渐渐进入一种空灵的状态。
就在此时，原本平静的识海内突然泛起一阵涟漪。
紧接着，那些血色古字所化的，108幅炼体图如同被唤醒一般，逐一浮现在金色识海之中。
看到这一幕，林道精神为之一振，心中暗喜：“看来我猜得没错，这金色识海果真能够将我记忆中的事物具象化！”
然而，惊喜之余，林道并未满足于此。
他集中精力，驱动着自己的心神开始凝聚起来。
只见那108幅炼体图，受到心神力量的牵引，开始剧烈地颤动起来。
随后，它们竟如同拼图一般，相互融合汇聚，最终形成了一个，小巧玲珑的金色小人。
这个金色小人身姿灵动，仿佛活物一般，开始依照着108幅图中人形的姿势和动作，开始修炼起来。

伴随着金色小人专心致志地修炼着，林道逐渐明白过来，自己仅仅只是这片神秘金色识海的，浅显运用罢了。
他静静地凝视着，金色小人的一举一动，心中不禁涌起层层思绪。
望着眼前不断变幻动作的金色小人，林道陷入了沉思之中。
突然间，一个惊人的念头闪过他的脑海里。
这金色小人正在修炼的，108幅炼体图绝不是人类能修炼的！
原因无他，只因这些炼体图上，所描绘的人形姿势，实在太过匪夷所思。
其中有好些动作，根本不是正常人体能够完成的。
倘若真有人胆敢尝试，去修炼这种炼体图，那么其后果将会不堪设想。
轻者经脉尽断，成为废人，重者直接爆体身亡，落得个凄惨下场。
回忆起，当时九死一生的场景，自己按照108幅图修炼时，当场就全身骨骼瞬间寸断。
想到此处，林道不由得倒吸一口凉气。
若非关键时刻，那滴金色血液发挥出了神奇作用，恐怕自己早已命丧黄泉了。
自己现在能修炼，应该是自己身体蜕变有关。
然而，尽管自身的肉体历经种种磨砺和蜕变，但他始终属于人类这一事实。
想到这里，林道心中已然明悟，清楚地知晓接下来应该采取何种行动。
content_en:
Lin Dao slowly sat down cross-legged, closed his eyes slightly, adjusted his breathing, and gradually sunk his mind into the mysterious golden sea of ​​consciousness.
He knew very well that he had no experience in practicing martial arts. If he wanted to create a powerful martial arts by himself, it would be as difficult as climbing to the sky.
However, he also understood that the skills were not innate, but were created by the wisdom and efforts of previous generations.
In this case, why can't I be the creator?
Thinking of this, a glimmer of hope ignited in Lin Dao's heart.
He turned his attention to the mysterious golden sea of ​​consciousness in his body.
His intuition told him that this might be the key to breaking through difficulties and opening up a new path.
After all, this golden sea of ​​consciousness gave him the miraculous ability of photographic memory.
Even the memories of past lives can be clearly presented in front of you like a movie.
However, these are just the tip of the iceberg displayed by the Golden Sea of ​​Consciousness.
In fact, Lin Dao already had some bold guesses about the true mystery of this sea of ​​consciousness.
As his mind continued to penetrate deeper into the golden sea of ​​consciousness, and time passed by, Lin Dao's consciousness gradually entered an ethereal state.
At this moment, ripples suddenly appeared in the originally calm sea of ​​consciousness.
Immediately afterwards, the 108 body refining diagrams transformed from those ancient blood-colored characters appeared one by one in the golden sea of ​​consciousness, as if being awakened.
Seeing this scene, Lin Dao's spirit was lifted, and he was secretly happy: "It seems that my guess was right. This golden sea of consciousness can really materialize the things in my memory!"
However, despite the surprise, Lindao was not satisfied with this.
He concentrated his energy and drove his mind to start to gather together.
I saw those 108 body training pictures, pulled by the power of the mind, began to tremble violently.
Then, they merged together like puzzle pieces, and finally formed a small and exquisite golden man.
This little golden figure had an agile posture, as if it were a living creature. It began to practice according to the postures and movements of the human figures in the 108 pictures.
As the golden villain concentrated on practicing, Lin Dao gradually understood that he was just a superficial user of this mysterious golden sea of ​​consciousness.
He stared quietly at the little golden man's every move, and he couldn't help but have layers of thoughts in his heart.
Looking at the constantly changing golden figure in front of him, Lindao fell into deep thought.
Suddenly, a startling thought flashed through his mind.
The 108 body training diagrams that this little golden man is practicing are definitely not something that humans can practice!
There is no other reason than that the humanoid postures depicted on these body training diagrams are simply too incredible.
There are many actions that cannot be completed by a normal human body.
If anyone dares to try and practice this kind of body training diagram, the consequences will be disastrous.
In the mild case, the meridians are cut off and the person becomes a disabled person; in the severe case, the body explodes and dies, ending in a miserable end.
Recalling the scene of a narrow escape from death, when I practiced according to the 108 pictures, all my bones were instantly broken on the spot.
Thinking of this, Lin Dao couldn't help but take a breath.
If it hadn't been for the miraculous effect of that drop of golden blood at the critical moment, I'm afraid he would have died long ago.
The fact that I can practice now should be related to the transformation of my body.
However, despite all the hardships and transformations his body has gone through, he still remains human.
Thinking of this, Lin Dao had a clear understanding in his heart and knew clearly what action he should take next.
